label: Month-End Close Checklist Runner
description: Guides through systematic month-end close procedures. Generates role-specific checklists, identifies unreconciled items, tracks completion status, and produces sign-off documentation.

claudeKnowledge.description: Month-end close best practices, reconciliation standards, IFRS/GAAP accrual principles

guidedInputs.label: Known open / unreconciled items
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List any items you know are outstanding:
e.g.
- Bank reconciliation: 3 items unmatched totalling 45 000 SEK
- Intercompany balance with DE subsidiary not confirmed
- Depreciation run not yet executed
- Accruals for IT consulting invoice not posted

guidedInputs.label: Team roles (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List team members and their roles to generate role-specific sub-checklists.
e.g.
- Anna (AP): accounts payable, supplier reconciliations
- Erik (AR): accounts receivable, collections
- Sofia (GL): general ledger, accruals, reporting
- Manager: review and sign-off

guidedInputs.label: Close deadline
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. 5 working days after month-end — 7 February 2025
